rungs.FULFILL/RETRY: Next edition in the window; second edition of the week if editions_per_market_week and the health budget permit
rungs.RESCHEDULE/ALTERNATE: Shippable/category edition; adjacent-market edition where geography supports it
rungs.SUBSTITUTE: Additional homepage module run + additional social post + final-days onsite placement; or a shortened dedicated closing send if a slot and the health budget allow
rungs.ESCALATE when: No edition can send before T−48h and no substitute is available

rungs.FULFILL/RETRY: Alternate slot inside [T−7d, T−3d]; 48h overlap spacing honoured
rungs.RESCHEDULE/ALTERNATE: Alternate scope by the 3F ladder (regional, category/shippable, nationwide when relevant); stop at the first scope clearing min_audience
rungs.SUBSTITUTE: Two additional shared-edition inclusions + additional hero days + lot-level promotion; paid promotion where authorized
rungs.ESCALATE when: Floor unreachable in every scope and substitutes exhausted

rungs.FULFILL/RETRY: Any 2 days inside the window; rotation up to max_concurrent
rungs.RESCHEDULE/ALTERNATE: Split days across the campaign; rotation share adjusted within config
rungs.SUBSTITUTE: Extended module run + additional lot-level promotion + additional dedicated closing send where health permits
rungs.ESCALATE when: Rotation saturated for the entire window and substitutes exhausted

rungs.RESCHEDULE/ALTERNATE: Split run; category top pin for the difference
rungs.SUBSTITUTE: Additional social post + targeted onsite promotion + Closing Soon extension

rungs.FULFILL/RETRY: Conditional insert retried; placement logging confirms first-seen
rungs.RESCHEDULE/ALTERNATE: Alternate surface of the same class (category pin ↔ listing priority)
rungs.SUBSTITUTE: Additional onsite placement of the next class up
rungs.ESCALATE when: Marketplace delivery surfaces unavailable for the whole window (an incident, not a capacity case)

rungs.RESCHEDULE/ALTERNATE: Alternate ACTIVE channel; manual_verified fallback routed here while no channel is ACTIVE
rungs.SUBSTITUTE: Additional onsite placement + an additional creative in the share kit
rungs.ESCALATE when: No channel ACTIVE and manual fallback unavailable

L_creative.applies: creative_collage_general, creative_closing_days, creative_lot_specific, creative_mid_refresh, creative_cobranded_variant, share_kit_delivery

rungs.FULFILL/RETRY: Re-run the compositor with a different family from CREATIVE_FAMILIES
rungs.RESCHEDULE/ALTERNATE: Category-group or single-lot family when the CLEAN object count is short
rungs.SUBSTITUTE: Additional lot creative(s) from CLEAN objects
rungs.ESCALATE when: Fewer than the minimum CLEAN objects for any family (fidelity review overdue)

rungs.FULFILL/RETRY: Flight retried on the same ACTIVE provider within authority
rungs.RESCHEDULE/ALTERNATE: Alternate ACTIVE provider; owned lot-level placement + social when none is ACTIVE
rungs.SUBSTITUTE: Owned inventory of comparable value: additional module run, closing-soon extension, additional shared-edition inclusion where eligible
rungs.ESCALATE when: Never for capacity; only for provider account revocation mid-flight with no owned substitute

rungs.FULFILL/RETRY: Send at publish; retry through the queue
rungs.SUBSTITUTE: Not applicable (where-applicable feature completes as not-applicable with reason)
